notes.title: Release of game Skufs and Alt-girls
notes.notes:
Hi! Yes, I know, I'm a little late with this post. The game "Skufs and Alt-girls" is available on Steam!

After completing the game for the first girl, new opportunities will open up for you. Continue playing for other characters!

And to get the full range of emotions - complete the game completely, reaching Zhenya's true ending.
If you have already played, I ask you to write a review and recommend the game to your friends, or even buy them a copy.

The game was not intended to be entirely superficial. You can explore  it, knock out rare achievements, look for Easter eggs, sites. Some players have encountered unresolved issues, so I suggest you participate and help them by sharing the ways in which you, for example, found a ticket to Japan playing for Yuna, or how you knocked out this or that achievement. (or answers to a test in the game). Write guides!

This is important for the game community.
